entry.title: A Practical Guide to Terraform Dependency Management
entry.summary: TL;DR Treat Terraform dependency management as two different systems: providers are selected and pinned via .terraform.lock.hcl (repeatable by default), while modules are not pinned by a lock file and can drift over time unless you pin an exact version or a git ref. Use bounded ranges for the Terraform CLI (required_version) and pessimistic constraints (~>) for providers in root modules. In reusable sub-modules, prefer broad minimums (plus optional upper bounds only when necessary), letting the root module do final resolution. For modules, choose explicitly between exact pins for maximum reproducibility, or ~> ranges for easier upgrades (with disciplined init -upgrade workflows).
